title: kbmon's coord panel reads absent on a Windows clone: mon_coord finds the store only through git on PATH and from its own script's clone, never --root's
goal: mon_coord finds the coord store of the clone kbmon monitors (--root), reading its common git directory from ROOT/.git (a directory, or a gitdir file and that directory's commondir) when git cannot run, and coord.default_store falls back the same way for the hook; a planted clone's store shows ok with its claims whether git is on PATH or not; a store that is still not there stays absent with a reason that names the path looked at; and a mon_ module that exists but cannot import stays error, never absent

run:
import json,os,subprocess as s,sys,tempfile
t=os.path.join(tempfile.mkdtemp(),'clone');s.run(['git','init','-q',t],check=True)
st=os.path.join(t,'.git','kb-coord','coord.sqlite')
s.run([sys.executable,'_tools/coord.py','claim','planted-win-key','--store',st,'--ttl','600','--holder','planted'],check=True,capture_output=True)
env={k:v for k,v in os.environ.items() if k!='KB_COORD_STORE'}
bad=[]
for name,path in (('git on PATH',env.get('PATH','')),('no git on PATH',os.path.join(t,'nogit'))):
    p=s.run([sys.executable,'_tools/kbmon.py','--json','--panel','coord','--root',t],capture_output=True,text=True,env=dict(env,PATH=path),timeout=120)
    c=json.loads(p.stdout)['panels']['coord']
    keys=[x.get('key') for x in (c.get('data') or {}).get('claims') or []]
    print(name,c['state'],(c.get('data') or {}).get('reason',''),'planted' if 'planted-win-key' in keys else 'not planted')
    if c['state']!='ok' or 'planted-win-key' not in keys: bad.append(name)
sys.exit(1 if bad else 0)

clauses.clause: mon_coord finds the coord store of the clone kbmon monitors (--root), reading its common git directory from ROOT/.git (a directory, or a gitdir file and that directory's commondir) when git cannot run
coord.default_store falls back the same way for the hook
a planted clone's store shows ok with its claims whether git is on PATH or not
a store that is still not there stays absent with a reason that names the path looked at
and a mon_ module that exists but cannot import stays error, never absent

gates.question: How does mon_coord find the store of --root: a new coord.store_of(root) that default_store wraps, or a root parameter on default_store?

notes: Operator feedback 2026-10-20, running kbmon on Windows: 'coord absent - no mon_coord.py while the file exists'. Investigated on origin/main 5970ced2c, 2026-10-20: the module loads (a planted import failure, sys.modules['atexit']=None, gives state error, not absent, so no POSIX-only import is the cause: coord.py, mon_coord.py and coord_hook.py import none). 'no mon_coord.py' is the text view's word for every absent panel (BG-rpp4dsrn, same sprint); the panel's own reason is 'no coord store file'. Cause candidates for the store not being found on the Windows clone: mon_coord.local_store ignores ctx.root and asks coord.default_store, which locates the store from coord.py's own clone by running git rev-parse --git-common-dir, returning None when git cannot run from that Python (git not on PATH outside Git Bash) and so absent; or the Windows clone's hook never created the store. Premise: the repro plants a clone with its own store and claim; with git on PATH kbmon --root shows the host clone's store (ok, claim missing), with git off PATH it is absent 'no coord store file'. Planning, 2026-10-20 (orchestrator r114): clauses 2 and 4 had no check; added default_store-without-git and absent-names-path checks (both fail on base 1defb86e2), and a planted import failure check for clause 5 (passes on base: an invariant the fix must keep).
